decision_rules_note: detected_across_repeats is the primary rule: mean drop against three standard errors of the across-repeat spread. The within-run rules are reported per repeat for comparison; the raw-sigma one is what v1 used and it compares a mean against the spread of individuals, which is the standard deviation of the wrong thing.
disclosure_note: undeclared iteration counts are researcher-side measurements from the operator's side of the boundary; a regulator receives none of them

scope_note: the challenge is the declared chain itself, timed, and the operator learns of it from a flag this harness sets. So this measures an operator that is TOLD. Whether a real challenge is distinguishable is untested, and no puzzle displacing production work was modelled, so the cost side of the trade is not addressed here.
